title: Influence of ALS-linked M337V mutation on the conformational ensembles of TDP-43(321-340) peptide monomer and dimer.
authors: Zeng, Jiyuan; Tang, Yiming; Dong, Xuewei; Li, Fangying; Wei, Guanghong
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子副本交换分子动力学模拟研究ALS相关M337V突变对TDP-43(321-340)肽段单体/二聚体构象集合的影响，聚焦蛋白自组装与相分离机制，属广义蛋白-DNA/RNA结合蛋白互作体系，但非典型TF-DNA结合，方法为MD模拟，与本课题部分相关。
abstract: The transactive response (TAR) DNA/RNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) can self-assemble into both functional stress granules via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) and pathogenic amyloid fibrillary aggregates that are closely linked to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Previous experimental studies reported that the low complexity domain (LCD) of TDP-43 plays an essential role in the LLPS and aggregation of the full-length protein, and it alone can also undergo LLPS to form liquid droplets mainly via intermolecular interactions in the 321-340 region. And the ALS-associated M337V mutation impairs LCD's LLPS and facilitates liquid-solid phase transition. However, the underlying atomistic mechanism is not well understood. Herein, as a first step to understand the M337V-caused LLPS disruption of TDP-43 LCD mediated by the 321-340 region and the fibrillization enhancement, we investigated the conformational properties of monomer/dimer of TDP-43(321-340) peptide and its M337V mutant by performing extensive all-atom explicit-solvent replica exchange molecular dynamic simulations. Our simulations demonstrate that M337V mutation alters the residue regions with high helix/beta-structure propensities and thus affects the conformational ensembles of both monomer and dimer. M337V mutation inhibits helix formation in the N-terminal Ala-rich region and the C-terminal mutation site region, while facilitating their long beta-sheet formation, albeit with a minor impact on the average probability of both helix structure and beta-structure. Further analysis of dimer system shows that M337V mutation disrupts inter-molecular helix-helix interactions and W334-W334 pi-pi stacking interactions which were reported to be important for the LLPS of TDP-43 LCD, whereas enhances the overall peptide residue-residue interactions and weakens peptide-water interactions, which is conducive to peptide fibrillization. This study provides mechanistic insights into the M337V-mutation-induced impairment of phase separation and facilitation of fibril formation of TDP-43 LCD.
abstract_zh: 反式激活反应（TAR）DNA/RNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）可通过液-液相分离（LLPS）自组装成功能性应激颗粒，也可形成与肌萎缩侧索硬化密切相关的致病性淀粉样纤维聚集体。先前的实验研究报告指出，TDP-43的低复杂度结构域（LCD）在全长蛋白的LLPS和聚集过程中发挥关键作用，且该结构域单独也能通过321-340区域内的分子间相互作用经历LLPS形成液滴。此外，与ALS相关的M337V突变会损害LCD的LLPS并促进液-固相转变。然而，其潜在的原子级机制尚不清楚。在此，作为理解M337V引起的由321-340区域介导的TDP-43 LCD LLPS破坏及纤维化增强的第一步，我们通过进行广泛的原子级显式溶剂副本交换分子动力学模拟，研究了TDP-43(321-340)肽段及其M337V突变体的单体/二聚体构象特性。我们的模拟表明，M337V突变改变了具有高螺旋/β-结构倾向性的残基区域，从而影响单体和二聚体的构象集合。M337V突变抑制了N端富含丙氨酸区域和C端突变位点区域的螺旋形成，同时促进其长β-折叠形成，尽管对螺旋结构和β-结构的平均概率影响较小。对二聚体系统的进一步分析显示，M337V突变破坏了分子间螺旋-螺旋相互作用和W334-W334 π-π堆积相互作用（这些相互作用据报道对TDP-43 LCD的LLPS至关重要），同时增强了整体肽段残基-残基相互作用并减弱了肽段-水相互作用，这有利于肽段纤维化。本研究为M337V突变诱导的TDP-43 LCD相分离受损及纤维形成促进提供了机制性见解。
